request.brief: Secure the Tsingtao Mandate, Imperial Japan's WW1 campaign for the German leased port in Shandong. The focus prepares the landing force and asserts a claim to the harbour. One pale masonry harbour battery and breakwater, shown close-up with an early twentieth-century open coastal gun emplacement. It must read as a fortified harbour, not a city skyline or generic battleship. At the lower edge of the artwork, integrate a small Japanese red sun disc into the actual metal rim, not as an overlay. Put the scene on a complete dark teal enamel diamond with an aged silver rim and a tiny restrained rope edge. Vanilla HOI4 painterly materials, strong silhouette, strong deep shadows and bright highlights, opaque scene and real alpha outside. No modern equipment, text, flags, map, communist symbols or German marks. Keep the fort centered and large, readable at 100×88.

prompt.text:
Create one Hearts of Iron IV national focus icon: Secure the Tsingtao Mandate, Imperial Japan's WW1 campaign for the German leased port in Shandong. The focus prepares the landing force and asserts a claim to the harbour. One pale masonry harbour battery and breakwater, shown close-up with an early twentieth-century open coastal gun emplacement. It must read as a fortified harbour, not a city skyline or generic battleship. At the lower edge of the artwork, integrate a small Japanese red sun disc into the actual metal rim, not as an overlay. Put the scene on a complete dark teal enamel diamond with an aged silver rim and a tiny restrained rope edge. Vanilla HOI4 painterly materials, strong silhouette, strong deep shadows and bright highlights, opaque scene and real alpha outside. No modern equipment, text, flags, map, communist symbols or German marks. Keep the fort centered and large, readable at 100×88.

Requirements:
- Take the frame, outline and overall form from the style anchor images, not from a fixed family form; the size, transparency, margin and readability requirements here still apply.
- Flags and ribbons use invented colours, never a real country's flag, unless the brief names that country.
- The subject is large: it fills most of the emblem and may overlap its frame, never a small figure inside a wide empty plaque.
- A strong central symbol that supports the focus's story, readable contrast at 100x88 pixels.
- Real transparent background around the emblem: no backdrop behind it.
- Leave a small empty margin around the emblem.

Reference images, in the order attached:
1. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
2. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
The style anchor images were chosen for this image. Match their form, framing, materials and palette; the vanilla form described under Requirements applies only where they do not show one.

Avoid: text; letters or numbers; watermark or signature; a drawn checkerboard pattern; a square backdrop behind the subject.

Produce exactly one image.
negative: a square backdrop behind the subject
